scope: Current-source local suite acceptance; no whole-product, hosted, live-provider, cross-platform or publication claim.
limitations: Execution evidence is local and platform-scoped; hosted, other-platform and live-provider acceptance are not inferred.

Not run: CompletionsGrammar, CompletionsThinking, Tui.SelectList, Terminal.SelectList.Integration, Tui.Focus, Tui.IndicConjunct, Tui.Keybindings, Tui.Keypad, Tui.KittyAlternate, Tui.LockModifiers, Tui.ModifyOtherKeys. They replay captured Source fixtures or need frozen evidence-admission inputs (source observations, review checkout, source manifest and build receipt) that this checkout does not hold; the tui and ai-providers packages built them only. They cover key decoding, the segmenter, the native TerminalSelectList and the Completions grammar and thinking replays, which the 1.6.0 changes did not touch.

Not accepted: GoogleGenerativeAI (36 of 37; google.native-diagnostics-preterminal-real-consumer-limit fails with "The JSON value of length 536870889 is too large") and OpenAIResponsesOriginalParity (70 of 76 records) fail identically on the base commit 343ece01, as the ai-providers report records; their results are reported, not accepted.

Not accepted: MistralOriginalOptions, OpenAIResponsesHooks, ResponsesGrammarFallback, ResponsesOrphan, VertexSimple exit 0 on the current source (ai-providers ran them), but they print their results as JSON records or only to a report file, which the validation owner (tools/GapValidation/CaseEvidence.ps1) does not read as case evidence, so their receipts show no selected cases.

No full-solution build receipt was recorded: Run-Tests fingerprints a solution file's whole directory, artifacts included, so it cannot give a source-stable PiSharp.slnx receipt. PiSharp.slnx built in Release with the pinned SDK 10.0.401 at ee1c8341 with a clean tracked tree, 0 warnings and 0 errors (2026-11-22, outside the receipt owner), and every required suite built its own project closure in its receipt.

packageValidation.note: Packaging is a later, separately recorded stage. This source acceptance does not claim package or install validation.
